description: This file defines a React component for an alert UI element, including sub-components for alert title and description. It uses class-variance-authority for styling variants and utility functions for class name concatenation.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: Main alert component accepting variant and styling props, rendering a styled div with accessibility roles and data attributes.
